d:
Watch Akshay Kumar groove with the hot Polish-German model Claudia Ciesla and south beauty Asin in the new Khiladi 786 song 'Balma'.
Composed by Himesh Reshammiya and sung by Sreerama Chandra and Shreya Ghoshal, the song is a tribute to the late R.D. Burman and you will notice the legendary musician's presence not just in the video but also in the composition.
Set it as your caller tune SMS KHLD3 to 54646
